thread:
eli-customer: Hey team — we started seeing a spike of 500s this morning for customers hitting our payment flow. All failing requests surface a tool/function call failure from Redwood.

eli-customer: Example runtime log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T08:04:12Z ERROR toolcall: invocation failed request_id=cli_01F23Z response_code=400 error="invalid argument: tool_id not a valid uuid" payload={"tool_id":"charge_card-v2","args":{"customer_id":"cus_123","amount":1999}}
```

eli-customer: Repro steps: our frontend posts to /checkout/create -> our backend calls Redwood function 'charge_card' via function-calling. Fails for ~30% of requests. Started ~08:00 UTC. Multiple customers hit failed payments.

maya-support: Thanks @eli-customer — sorry about this. Can you paste the raw request body you sent to Redwood (sanitized) and the x-redwood-request-id headers for a few failures? Is this across models or one model? Any recent deploys on your side?

eli-customer: Raw (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/outputs
{"model":"gpt-infer-3.1","input":"charge card","function_call":{"name":"charge_card"},"tools":[{"id":"charge_card-v2","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"}}}}],"tool_input":{"tool_id":"charge_card-v2","args":{"customer_id":"cus_123","amount":1999}}
```

eli-customer: We didn't change anything on our side. Worked fine yesterday. Fails on both gpt-infer-3.1 and a smaller fallback model.

maya-support: Got it. Escalating to eng now, sharing the sanitized payload and sample request_ids. tagging @jordan-eng.

jordan-eng: Looking. Initial hypothesis: runtime now enforces tool_id UUID format for internal routing. Historically we accepted human-friendly tool ids (name strings) due to a compatibility migration layer. A config flip rolled out at ~07:58 UTC that enables strict validation. That would cause 400 with "tool_id not a valid uuid" if callers send names like "charge_card-v2".

jordan-eng: Can you confirm the registered tool object in your org matches a UUID id (e.g. "tld_01AB234") vs the name string you pass? If you only registered a name (or used an alias), the new check will reject it.

eli-customer: Our console shows tool name "charge_card-v2" (we thought that was the id). We do have an internal uuid for the tool but our backend sets tool_id to the name.

jordan-eng: OK — that explains the partial failure rate: some requests were routed via an older cache layer that still accepted names; others hit nodes with the new validation flag. Mitigations:
- Short term workaround: change request payload to send the registered tool UUID in tool_id (or add a tool_alias field mapping to your name).
- Immediate remediation we can do: create a server-side alias mapping for your org that maps "charge_card-v2" -> your UUID. If you want that, share org_id and 3 failing x-redwood-request-id values and we can patch the mapping.
- Medium term: we're rolling a soft rollback on the strict validation flag to restore tolerant behavior for 15m while we patch the registry migration and add compatibility tests.

ops-bot: deploy:kernel:toolid-validation=true applied at 2026-03-17T07:58:00Z on rollout-group=runtime-prod-02 (intent: enable strict tool_id validation)

luis-sre: Acknowledged. Initiating soft rollback on runtime-prod-02 for traffic=100% -> 0% gradually; target: restore tolerant parsing within next 15m. Will monitor error-rate and token latency.

eli-customer: Please do the alias patch if possible, we need payments unblocked now. Sending sample request_ids: cli_01F23Z, cli_01F24Y, cli_01F2AB. Org id: org_77X.

jordan-eng: Received. Creating alias mapping now and will confirm when live. Also sharing a short snippet you can use immediately as a client quick fix: replace tool_id value with the tool's UUID returned from the /tools list endpoint. Example patch (node):
```js
// quick client fix
const toolUuid = "tld_0a1b2c"; // your registered id from /v1/tools
await fetch('/v1/outputs', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ ..., tool_input: { tool_id: toolUuid, args: {...} }}) });
```

maya-support: Thanks everyone. We'll update this thread when alias mapping and/or rollback complete and follow with an internal postmortem note. :thumbsup:

jordan-eng: Alias mapping live at 1772103500, please verify. luis-sre: monitoring shows error rate dropping back to baseline.

eli-customer: Confirmed — failures dropped to normal after alias live. Thanks for the fast response. Please include a postmortem and an SDK note so other customers don't hit this.

maya-support: Will do. Follow-up: we'll publish mitigation steps and recommend tool_id use be the UUID in integration docs.
